resources.string: The %1$s model is on your device
Used by both the app and the keyboard. Also in Settings → Microphone Behavior.
Press and hold the mic, release to transcribe
Tap to start, tap again to transcribe
Dictate into any app with your voice
Speak instead of typing, in any app
The Veena keyboard puts a mic in WhatsApp, Messages, Gmail — anywhere you type. What you say is transcribed on this phone by the same offline models as the Veena app.
Works offline, after the one-time model download
Private: audio and text never leave your phone
Open your keyboard settings and switch on Veena Voice Keyboard. Android warns that any keyboard can see what you type; Veena only listens while you dictate and keeps nothing.
The keyboard listens only between tapping the mic and inserting the text. Audio never leaves your phone.
Turn on Microphone in Veena\'s app settings
The keyboard can dictate in a different language than the app. You can switch any time from the language button on the keyboard.
Switch to Veena and try it
On any keyboard, tap the globe key — or the keyboard button at the bottom of the screen — to switch to Veena. On Veena, the globe takes you back.
Tap here, then tap the mic and speak

Keyboards that work with other voice input apps — SwiftKey, FUTO Keyboard, HeliBoard, AnySoftKeyboard and more — can open Veena from their own mic key. Turn on Veena voice input in your keyboard settings: tap the mic, speak, and Veena puts the text in and hands you straight back.
Gboard and Samsung Keyboard only use their own voice typing; with those, switch to Veena with the globe key. If the mic key still opens Google voice typing, turn that off in the same list.
Switch to Veena whenever you\'d rather talk than type. The first dictation loads the voice model, so give it a second.
The keyboard can use a different language than the app. Its model downloads once, and dictation runs fully offline.
